001package org.clafer.ir.compiler;
002
003import java.util.Map;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.Solution;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.BoolVar;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.clafer.collection.Either;
009import org.clafer.ir.IrBoolVar;
010import org.clafer.ir.IrIntVar;
011import org.clafer.ir.IrSetVar;
012import org.clafer.ir.IrStringVar;
013import org.clafer.ir.analysis.deduction.Coalesce;
014
015/**
016 * Maps IR non-constant variables to their translated Choco variables. IR
017 * variables can be optimized away. The get&lt;Type&gt;Var methods will return
018 * either the constant it optimized to or the Choco variable. The
019 * get&lt;Type&gt;Value will return the value, regardless of the optimizations.
020 * The get&lt;Type&gt;Value methods are undefined if the solver has not found a
021 * solution yet.
022 *
023 * @author jimmy
024 */
025public class IrSolutionMap {
026
027    private final Coalesce coalesce;
028    private final Map<IrIntVar, IntVar> intVars;
029    private final Map<IrSetVar, SetVar> setVars;
030
031    IrSolutionMap(
032            Coalesce coalesce,
033            Map<IrIntVar, IntVar> intVars,
034            Map<IrSetVar, SetVar> setVars) {
035        this.coalesce = coalesce;
036        this.intVars = intVars;
037        this.setVars = setVars;
038    }
039
040    public Either<Boolean, BoolVar> getVar(IrBoolVar var) {
041        IrBoolVar boolVar = coalesce.get(var);
042        if (boolVar.isConstant()) {
043            return Either.left(boolVar.getLowBound() == 1 ? Boolean.TRUE : Boolean.FALSE);
044        }
045        return Either.right((BoolVar) intVars.get(boolVar));
046    }
047
048    protected int getIntVal(IntVar var) {
049        return var.getValue();
050    }
051
052    protected int[] getSetVal(SetVar var) {
053        return var.getValue().toArray();
054    }
055
056    public IrSolutionMap fromSolution(final Solution solution) {
057        return new IrSolutionMap(coalesce, intVars, setVars) {
058
059            @Override
060            protected int getIntVal(IntVar var) {
061                return solution.getIntVal(var);
062            }
063
064            @Override
065            protected int[] getSetVal(SetVar var) {
066                return solution.getSetVal(var);
067            }
068        };
069    }
070
071    public Either<Boolean, BoolVar>[] getVars(IrBoolVar... vars) {
072        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
073        Either<Boolean, BoolVar>[] bvars = (Either<Boolean, BoolVar>[]) new Either<?, ?>[vars.length];
074        for (int i = 0; i < bvars.length; i++) {
075            bvars[i] = getVar(vars[i]);
076        }
077        return bvars;
078    }
079
080    public boolean getValue(IrBoolVar var) {
081        Either<Boolean, BoolVar> boolVar = getVar(var);
082        return boolVar.isLeft()
083                ? boolVar.getLeft()
084                : getIntVal(boolVar.getRight()) != 0;
085    }
086
087    public boolean[] getValues(IrBoolVar... vars) {
088        boolean[] bvalues = new boolean[vars.length];
089        for (int i = 0; i < bvalues.length; i++) {
090            bvalues[i] = getValue(vars[i]);
091        }
092        return bvalues;
093    }
094
095    public Either<Integer, IntVar> getVar(IrIntVar var) {
096        IrIntVar intVar = coalesce.get(var);
097        if (intVar.isConstant()) {
098            return Either.left(intVar.getLowBound());
099        }
100        return Either.right(intVars.get(intVar));
101    }
102
103    public Either<Integer, IntVar>[] getVars(IrIntVar... vars) {
104        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
105        Either<Integer, IntVar>[] ivars = (Either<Integer, IntVar>[]) new Either<?, ?>[vars.length];
106        for (int i = 0; i < ivars.length; i++) {
107            ivars[i] = getVar(vars[i]);
108        }
109        return ivars;
110    }
111
112    public IntVar[] getIntVars() {
113        return intVars.values().toArray(new IntVar[intVars.size()]);
114    }
115
116    public int getValue(IrIntVar var) {
117        Either<Integer, IntVar> intVar = getVar(var);
118        return intVar.isLeft()
119                ? intVar.getLeft()
120                : getIntVal(intVar.getRight());
121    }
122
123    public int[] getValues(IrIntVar... vars) {
124        int[] ivalues = new int[vars.length];
125        for (int i = 0; i < ivalues.length; i++) {
126            ivalues[i] = getValue(vars[i]);
127        }
128        return ivalues;
129    }
130
131    public Either<int[], SetVar> getVar(IrSetVar var) {
132        IrSetVar setVar = coalesce.get(var);
133        if (setVar.isConstant()) {
134            return Either.left(setVar.getKer().getValues());
135        }
136        return Either.right(setVars.get(setVar));
137    }
138
139    public Either<int[], SetVar>[] getVars(IrSetVar... vars) {
140        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
141        Either<int[], SetVar>[] svars = (Either<int[], SetVar>[]) new Either<?, ?>[vars.length];
142        for (int i = 0; i < svars.length; i++) {
143            svars[i] = getVar(vars[i]);
144        }
145        return svars;
146    }
147
148    public SetVar[] getSetVars() {
149        return setVars.values().toArray(new SetVar[setVars.size()]);
150    }
151
152    public int[] getValue(IrSetVar var) {
153        Either<int[], SetVar> setVar = getVar(var);
154        return setVar.isLeft()
155                ? setVar.getLeft()
156                : getSetVal(setVar.getRight());
157    }
158
159    public int[][] getValues(IrSetVar... vars) {
160        int[][] svalues = new int[vars.length][];
161        for (int i = 0; i < svalues.length; i++) {
162            svalues[i] = getValue(vars[i]);
163        }
164        return svalues;
165    }
166
167    public String getValue(IrStringVar var) {
168        int[] charints = getValues(var.getCharVars());
169        char[] chars = new char[charints.length];
170        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
171            assert charints[i] >= Character.MIN_VALUE && charints[i] <= Character.MAX_VALUE;
172            chars[i] = (char) charints[i];
173        }
174        int length = getValue(var.getLengthVar());
175        return new String(chars, 0, length);
176    }
177
178    public String[] getValues(IrStringVar... vars) {
179        String[] svalues = new String[vars.length];
180        for (int i = 0; i < svalues.length; i++) {
181            svalues[i] = getValue(vars[i]);
182        }
183        return svalues;
184    }
185}
